name: @seeya-ai/app
description: Desktop interface for seeya (D-042): an embedded terminal (Electron + @xterm/xterm + node-pty) that shows the sessions this machine discovers and lets a person open the harness in a tab. Second composition root (D-043) — consumes @seeya-ai/engine in-process, never as a subprocess of @seeya-ai/cli.
